description: Pins for every dependency the pipeline fetches when the local cache is cold. bootstrap.sh reads this file; keep it in sync with temporal/cybergen/references/linux-v8-workspace.md, which is authoritative for the V8/depot_tools half.

depot_tools.note: CyberGen's reference pins 364ccfdd5f1346dc973b66ab5f088a4ec88ca8c6; this cache carries fa754cb8. Both work for the gclient/V8 sync this pipeline needs. DEPOT_TOOLS_UPDATE=0 is required when invoking it by hand.

v8.note: One checkout serves both roles: `git archive <rev>` supplies gni/ and test/ for each problem's own revision, and it is the hardlink fallback for build/, buildtools/, third_party/ and tools/. Problems spanning older revisions need those revisions present: `git fetch origin <rev>` before generating their build inputs. Run `sudo ./build/install-build-deps.sh` once on a fresh host.

gn.note: The archive already contains gn plus .cipdpkg/manifest.json; unzip in place. This is the revision V8 DEPS pins for the revisions in use, and image-build-inner.sh downloads the same URL.

gn-args-vuln.note: Five hand-authored GN args files; small enough to vendor, so nothing is fetched.

pkg-config-wrapper.sh.note: glibc-independent pkg-config shim; vendored. It is a Python script despite the .sh suffix.

registry.note: docker login is required; credentials live in ~/.docker/config.json.
